CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2580 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0. Bus nonce: 8e37cf7e0725edace0214e6642ad697b. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0` or `Fix review: blocked caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8e37cf7e0725edace0214e6642ad697b`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2580 caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2580-8e37cf7e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW of PR #2580 (group R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, branch fix/r10-flow-relay-hold) at moved head caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0. That head is a main absorb: a merge of 056776d8754930075a030426dd807208e0fd2bc3 and origin/main 16a8240f. The last verdict, at 056776d8, was blocked contract-red: pr-contract's carry_audit refused "Carry: R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE" as BAD-DEST because the group was not yet on main's roster. #2588 has since merged (0d50ed2de), so confirm that block is cleared at this head. Read it with `git fetch origin review/2580; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, using the finder's harness the group brief names (roster origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, read with jq). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Judge the conflict resolution in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py, the MUTANTS tail: a union of cloud_relay-1..11 and main's tick_loop/heartbeat tuples. Confirm no side's mutant was dropped, by comparing `git show 056776d8:<file>` and `git show 16a8240f:<file>` with the head. Confirm cloud_relay.sh, INSTRUMENTS.md and the delivery row auto-merged without losing either side. Check `git diff 16a8240f caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0` for anything beyond the PR's own change.
- Re-run the mutation proof: every harness mutant is KILLED (the body says 59, 0 survivors), the cloud_relay self-test passes, and selftest_wiring is 76/76. Run the finder's harness at both ends, and give a null control for every quantified claim.
- Re-measure every figure in the body, including ## Main absorb and ## Head.
- carry_audit.py check over the body, with and without --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, reports 0 unrouted. Every Carry you write names a live group on main's roster.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" / "API is unreachable" (06:27Z onward) is external. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main caac2c8dfb338b316803b94ba1df13aff02647e0 must be clean.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 8e37cf7e0725edace0214e6642ad697b. No /Users/ or /private/ path in VERDICT.md or ev/.
